description:
The candidate will be expected to play a significant role in the coding and unit testing of business, data access, and user interface logic for a high-profile financial application delivered over the web and through a back end messaging infrastructure.
 Experience is expected in a variety of back- and front-end enterprise Java technologies – with a heavy emphasis in the early phase of the engagement on the User Interface development that requires experience with Javascript (AngularJS) and Web services (SOAP, RESTful)
 Backend technology experience should include Java Enterprise Edition, Enterprise Java Beans 3.0, JPA, and JMS as well as Database experience with Oracle and MySQL. 
 
 Strong debugging and testing skills are necessary along with knowledge using JUnit, Maven, and Eclipse. A background in financial services will be a plus.

 
 To know more on this position or to schedule an interview, please contact;
